# Apps catalog

Every App of the deployment, from `backend/apps.json`: its tier, the modules it groups, the Apps those modules require and the ones they only integrate with. An App is what a clinic chooses; a module is what the code is made of ([ADR 0036](adr/0036-an-app-is-a-declared-group-of-modules.md), [ADR 0043](adr/0043-the-workspace-is-the-base-app.md)).

Maintained by `backend/scripts/generate_catalogs.py`. CI fails if `apps.json` or a manifest changes without re-generation. What each App is for lives in `docs/apps/<app>/README.md`.
